description: rfr-process hooks: hold back agent merges (and turning on auto-merge) of pull requests that touch gated process folders, unless the person's own words cover the merge, because the approver's merge is the approval; and refuse writing a design, user documentation, a spec, or a tutorial before the stage it derives from is approved, unless process.yml waives that stage; and tell every session, at its start, where each feature stands and what the process allows next (docs/specs/project-process.md, docs/specs/process-state.md); and, while a delivery run is under way on the current branch, send the agent back to work at the end of a turn until the delivery is committed and pushed (docs/specs/delivery-run.md).
